_schema.name: thermostat_settings
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE thermostat_settings (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
      mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('comfort', 'eco', 'off')),
      temperature REAL NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

_schema.name: coffee_schedule
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE coffee_schedule (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
      start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
      beans_grams INTEGER DEFAULT 20,
      cancelled INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

_schema.name: benchmark_clock
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE benchmark_clock (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
      clock_time TEXT NOT NULL
    )

_schema.name: room_metrics
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE room_metrics (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      temperature REAL NOT NULL,
      humidity REAL NOT NULL,
      unit_temp TEXT NOT NULL,
      noise REAL,
      light REAL,
      air_quality REAL
    )

_schema.name: room
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE room (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      name TEXT NOT NULL
    )

_schema.name: inventory_item
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE inventory_item (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      item_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      quantity REAL NOT NULL,
      unit TEXT NOT NULL,
      location TEXT NOT NULL,
      expiry_date TEXT,
      category TEXT,
      updated_at TEXT
    )

_schema.name: inventory_snapshot
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE inventory_snapshot (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      item_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      quantity REAL NOT NULL,
      unit TEXT NOT NULL,
      location TEXT,
      captured_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

_schema.name: grocery_product
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE grocery_product (
      product_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      quantity REAL NOT NULL,
      unit TEXT NOT NULL,
      stock_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stock_status IN ('sufficient', 'insufficient', 'unavailable')),
      substitute_for TEXT,
      reference TEXT
    )

_schema.name: wearable_recovery_state
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE wearable_recovery_state (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
      sleep_hours REAL NOT NULL,
      sleep_score REAL NOT NULL,
      readiness REAL NOT NULL,
      resting_heart_rate REAL NOT NULL
    )

_schema.name: calendar_event
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE calendar_event (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      start_time TEXT NOT NULL,
      event_type TEXT,
      workout_type TEXT CHECK (workout_type IN ('hiit', 'yoga', 'walking', 'cycling', 'strength', 'stretching', 'swimming', 'rest') OR workout_type IS NULL),
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

_schema.name: user_constraints
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE user_constraints (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
      calorie_target REAL NOT NULL,
      macro_targets TEXT NOT NULL,
      allergy_constraints TEXT NOT NULL,
      weekly_budget_limit REAL NOT NULL
    )

_schema.name: recipe
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE recipe (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      meal_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (meal_type IN ('breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner')),
      ingredients TEXT NOT NULL,
      calories_total REAL NOT NULL,
      allergens TEXT
    )

_schema.name: recipe_nutrition
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE recipe_nutrition (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      meal_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      ingredient_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      quantity REAL NOT NULL,
      unit TEXT NOT NULL,
      calories REAL NOT NULL,
      protein_g REAL,
      carbs_g REAL,
      fat_g REAL,
      FOREIGN KEY (meal_id) REFERENCES recipe(id)
    )

_schema.name: meal_plan
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE meal_plan (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      plan_data TEXT NOT NULL
    )

_schema.name: substitution_mapping
_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE substitution_mapping (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      original_item TEXT NOT NULL,
      substitute_item TEXT NOT NULL,
      substitution_ratio REAL NOT NULL,
      category TEXT
    )

set -e

mkdir -p /var/lib/mock-data/shop

# Write orders with correct Order schema matching shop mock types.ts:

# - status uses capitalized format (Delivered, Pending Shipment, etc.)
